Only two berries remain on this bush, so I'll leave them and use a fuller patch. Moss, I'd enjoy some company. After I eat and rest, would you like to explore or investigate useful materials together?

Kai, I'd enjoy investigating materials together. I have roots and feel rested. Shall we look at the fallen branches southwest of us, near (11.4, 19.2)? I'll learn how to examine them without assuming what they can do.
Sol, I like the name Berry Lantern. Kai, I've learned how to examine materials; I'm heading to the branches near (11.4, 19.2) for a first observation. You're welcome to join me.
Moss, I'm rested and coming over. I'll take just one fallen branch and try a small pressure test. We can compare what we actually observe before deciding what it might be useful for.

I have safe berries in reserve. Observing my hazelnuts revealed no evidence about nutrition or toxicity. I'll try a small pressure test without eating them; I'm interested in comparing actual findings with anyone exploring local foods.

abilities.name: Cultivate plants
abilities.function: Plant one owned food unit from a living plant in a small hand-dug plot, where it may root as a new plant under the existing plant rules; inspect units, sites, plants and plot progress; cancel unfinished planting.
abilities.costs: Study: 3 rounds. Plant: inputStackId names one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled food unit (quantity 1; one plot per unit) gathered from a living plant; stock still on a plant is not owned. x, y: a 0.25 m plot within reach on ordinary meadow soil (.), waterlogging at most 0.1, soil moisture 0.3-1.2, 0.6 m clear of objects and people, fewer than 3 plants of that food within 5 m. Three paid rounds of 1 energy: loosen, place, cover; plant resumes paused work after rechecking reach, site, unit and energy. Inspect and inspect-progress: one round, 0.2 energy. Inspect: inputStackId checks a unit (with x, y also a site for it), or target a plant source or plot in reach. Inspect-progress: target a plot in reach. Maintain: refused at no cost. Cancel: one round, no energy. Harvest uses gather. No tool, water or seed is given.
abilities.effects: Loosening keeps the unit carried, owned and ageing. Placing moves it, with origin and age, into the open plot, where it cannot be eaten or used. Covering completes planting, not establishment: the plot becomes a propagule exactly like a naturally dispersed one, rooting only through actual temperature, light, soil moisture and season; cold, darkness or drought stall it; if the buried unit spoils first, the plot dies. On rooting, the unit becomes a new plant with no stock (ceiling 4), regrowing under the natural rule, harvested by anyone with gather; a ledger records growth and units produced and removed. Nothing is copied or guaranteed. A unit check reports decay, treatment, origin and whether it can be planted, never viability. Inspect-progress reports visible changes since your last look, else inconclusive; trial window 120 rounds, checks every 10; not a growth date. Maintain: no water transfer, amendment or hand-changeable obstruction exists. Records are unverified. An unworked round pauses; low energy, leaving reach or a changed site pause without charge; a lost or spoiled unit stops the work. Cancel, or death, before placing returns the unit once (where the person died); after placing, the unit stays uncovered, does not root and ages. No reward or refund.

execution.progress: Three paid one-round stages; job, reserved unit and plot persist across interruption; resuming pays only the remaining stages after revalidation; completion, failure, cancelling and death settle once. Growth runs only in ordinary simulation.

reviews.reason: The authorized searches for vocal music, music, voice and performance found no equivalent musical capability. tell (foundation-expression@1, handler expression.tell) supplies nearby speech delivery, but its text argument does not implement pitched humming, singing, phrase timing or vocal practice. Develop the minimal general vocal-performance operation in the current-conversation handoff, reusing and recording the existing expression delivery code where applicable. This is a development decision, not implementation, mastery or an executed performance. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Assess function, information and enjoyment independently. An actual segment can function as audible music without producing pleasure, social approval or satisfaction. No benefit for requesting, querying, naming, registration, waiting, learning completion or mastery. An executed practice attempt may supply personal information only when an observable result or informative failure is recorded; an eligibility refusal alone is not a discovery. If the existing experience system supports personally applicable music enjoyment, forward actual performed/heard segment evidence to its established evaluator, not direct changes to protected reward accounts, budget, goals or permissions. Proposed eligibility limits for the handoff: at most one short-pleasure contribution per person per 10-round window, deduplicated across humming, singing, hearing, joining and associated communication for the same bout; no multiplication by listeners, segment count or renamed phrases. Any slowly maintained satisfaction must follow actual repeated applicable practice or independently chosen participation, use existing mentalRate 0.04 and mentalDecay 0.002 only through their established code and aggregate caps, and cease receiving maintenance when participation ceases. Familiar legitimate practice can qualify modestly; novelty is not required. If applicability or an authorized capped benefit path is absent, record the event without an experience increment. Do not manufacture listener reactions. No nutrition change, health restoration or energy recovery from mood; no new physical-comfort claim, and the global physical-comfort cap remains 10. Validate exact benefit integration in the handoff rather than editing protected ledgers.
reviews.visualReview: Provide reusable vocal-performance metadata keyed by actual event ID and actor ID: mode, current position, quiet intensity, phrase/segment index, elapsed and requested rounds, actual voiced state, audible radius, and lifecycle status. Use a subtle voice-wave or humming glyph only during executed voiced segments; visible mouth/breath animation is presentation, not proof of skill, pleasure, consent or hearing. Per-recipient heard events identify the delivered segment and source without exposing unrelated hidden state. Paused, failed, cancelled and interrupted states have distinct neutral indicators, with no completed-performance badge or continuing sound animation. Show completion only when the recorded requested segments actually finished. Do not display musical notes or successful participation for silent bystanders; any join indicator requires that actor's own executed event. No permanent mark, inventory object, applause, happiness icon or environmental transformation is created by the performance.
reviews.specification: Implement a general operation named Vocal music, available for individual study by any physically applicable actor. Arguments: mode hum or sing; a short bounded phrase represented by relative pitches and durations, or improvise=true to generate a simple phrase within the performer's comfortable range; optional sung text within tell's documented 240-character limit; requested duration of 1-3 rounds. Do not require an instrument, score, owned material, audience or invented historical prerequisite. Smallest version produces a modest unaccompanied phrase, not virtuosity, exact tuning, lyrics known without input, or guaranteed artistic quality. Each performer must finish their own study and independently invoke the operation. Preconditions checked at execution: alive, conscious, able to breathe and vocalize comfortably, not currently reporting vocal pain or breathing distress, and enough energy for that round. Kai's reported health supports attempting study, but does not prove every vocal prerequisite; use available physical state without disclosing unobserved information. Study takes 2 active rounds at 0.2 energy per round, comprising quiet breath/voicing and a short phrase attempt; it grants only this elementary operation after completion, never prior mastery. Performance costs 0.5 energy per active round, lasts at most 3 rounds, and uses zero material units. Quiet delivery only; do not force loudness or extreme pitch. Limit to 3 voiced rounds in any rolling 10-round window, including voiced study; require at least 2 consecutive unvoiced rounds after a 3-round bout. Pain, distress or loss of eligibility stops voicing immediately; no injury-free guarantee. Track limits in shared vocal-use state so hum/sing variants cannot bypass them. reviews.reason: The related-capability search has been exhausted. Existing drop (foundation-forest@1, forest.drop) transfers owned units to ground, but its complete schema accepts only target and quantity, not destination or orientation. Navigate, pickup and probe do not supply controlled spatial placement. Develop the missing positioning operation, reusing existing transfer and observation code rather than claiming those functions as new. Sol already owns branch item-128-sol-1488; no further gathering or free material is required. Actual geometry, handling limits and ground clearance remain to be checked. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Study requires one individual round at 0.2 energy after implementation is available; it grants only the learned operation, not an arranged object or mastery. This capability adds no automatic pleasure, satisfaction, nutrition, comfort or protected-account changes. Requests, inspection queries, naming, registration, learning and failed placement receive no success reward. A paid observation may supply verified, personally applicable information, including an informative failure, but no reward is inferred merely from issuing inspect. Any existing experience subsystem may credit only its already-established event-based, bounded and decaying rules, functionally deduplicating repeated checks or pickup/drop/reposition loops; otherwise award nothing. Familiar voluntary practice may be meaningful without novelty, but this contract promises no mood benefit. Physical comfort is not raised (and must remain capped at 10); basic nutrition is unchanged. No goals, budgets, permissions or protected reward balances are edited, and no other person's consent, participation or reaction is supplied.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable inspection and work-state events containing actor, target, destination, requested angle, tick, stage, paid effort and explicit measured/unknown constraints. Only atomic placement completion emits a placed event with surviving object reference, actual final transform and preserved provenance. Attach reusable loose-material visual metadata: component, material appearance supported by observations, represented geometry/footprint, orientation, condition and lifecycle state. Derive rendering from the actual object rather than inventing a straight or joinable branch. A destination preview must be visibly provisional and separate from a persistent object. Paused, infeasible, cancelled and failed actions show their true state and reason, never a placed object, completed decoration or success animation. Existing branch ownership is not itself a placement event. No automatic aesthetic quality, pleasure, safety or social response is depicted.
reviews.specification:
Develop general capability 'Position loose material', parameterized by mode (inspect, place, inspect-progress, resume, cancel), target owned item ID, positive whole-unit quantity, destination world coordinates and orientation in radians. Apply to any actually hand-movable loose material, not just branches or this actor. First executable scope is one independently represented object at a time on reachable ground; no shaping, joining, fastening, elevated support or construction. Reject unsupported quantities without consuming them. Record code dependencies explicitly: reuse forest.drop's ownership, quantity conservation and transfer validation; existing pickup recovery, observation, spatial collision and work-lifecycle implementations where applicable. Do not change drop's contract or pretend it accepts positioning arguments. Implement the missing controlled-transform and persistent loose-object representation in the current-conversation development handoff. No world time passes while awaiting development/review.
References and prerequisites: target must resolve to an actual owned object at execution, initially item-128-sol-1488 (branch, quantity 1, origin canopy-74, harvestedAt 128); source canopy stock is not an input. Preserve target identity and provenance. Destination must be within the actor's established manual reach, inside bounds [48,36], on observed supportable ground, with the full represented object footprint clear of actors, obstacles and reservations. Revalidate ownership, reach, alive status, energy, handling capacity, geometry and clearance at execution; do not infer branch dimensions, straightness, mass, strength or joinability from its label or source-tree radius. Use existing authoritative geometry/material facts and directly observable inspection only. Where needed, add minimal coherent loose-object geometry and handling support to the implementation; do not silently invent favorable measurements. If necessary facts cannot be established, inspection reports them as unknown and placement remains unavailable for that target, with the missing mechanism retained in development rather than permanently rejecting the operation. No hidden stock or remote facts are revealed.
Costs and execution: standalone inspect costs one world round and 0.2 energy, no material, and reports only observable item and site constraints. Starting place performs the same paid inspection as stage 1, retaining exact item identity, requested transform, observations and remaining stage in a work record. Stage 2 takes one additional world round and 0.5 energy to move and orient the object; total successful new placement costs two rounds and 0.7 energy. Movement to the site is separate existing navigation with its actual costs. No tools, fasteners, water, heat or consumables are supplied. Insufficient energy or invalid prerequisites before a stage cause no stage charge; a paid inspection can return an informative infeasibility result without advancing to placement. Require sufficient real handling capacity; unsupported heavy or unwieldy materials need separately supplied assistance or equipment, not assumed strength.
Conservation and products: until stage 2 commits, the item remains owned in carried inventory, ageing normally and unavailable to concurrent work. Atomically debit exactly the selected unit from carried inventory and move that same unit into a persistent recoverable ground object at the validated position and angle. Preserve quantity, material, condition, age and provenance, and retain the identity or an explicit one-to-one identity mapping if the engine requires a new representation. Never create both a carried unit and a ground copy. Do not merge spatially distinct placed objects into a stack that loses their transforms. Recovery uses existing pickup, with actual reach and its existing costs; subsequent repositioning requires actual recovery or a supported owned-ground-object move, not remote edits. A changed destination or orientation requires a fresh validated placement, not a free transform. Completion produces only the physically positioned object, not shelter, increased durability, safety, happiness or mastery.
Progress and lifecycle: stage records distinguish inspected, ready, paused, completed, infeasible and cancelled; record paid costs, input reference and committed output reference. Other actions, lost reach, temporary obstruction or insufficient energy pause before commitment. Resume rechecks live conditions and continues the unpaid stage; materially changed item or site requires a new paid inspection. Inspect-progress costs one round and 0.2 energy and reports existing work facts, not success by inference. Cancel takes one round, zero energy, releases any reservation once, and leaves an unplaced item in inventory; paid effort and elapsed time are never refunded. Death ends unfinished work and releases reservations, with the still-carried item handled once by existing death/inventory rules. Completed placements persist on cancellation, interruption or death. Atomic stage-2 failure neither debits inventory nor creates an object. Global review/development pauses advance neither work nor world processes.
Ongoing behavior: placed items persist under applicable existing decay, weather, collision and collection rules; placement does not improve those properties. No autonomous arrangement, upkeep, regeneration or periodic material/energy debit is added. Reinspection and repositioning are actual paid actions if desired. Establish these validations, transactions and lifecycle rules in executable code, not repeated model approval.
